claims.content: To allow a Customer to submit a bid for an item listed in an active auction, resulting in the recording of the bid and potential confirmation.

goal.raw_text: To allow a Customer to submit a bid for an item listed in an active auction, resulting in the recording of the bid and potential confirmation.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer is signed in to the system via the Sign-in Page.
The Customer has navigated to the Product Details (Bidding) page for a specific auction item.
The auction item is currently active and available for bidding (i.e., not ended or cancelled).
The Customer enters a bid amount on the Product Details (Bidding) page and submits it.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer enters a bid amount on the Product Details (Bidding) page and submits it.

claims.content: The Customer navigates to the Product Details (Bidding) page for the desired item.
The Customer enters a bid amount and submits the bid on the Product Details (Bidding) page.
The system displays the Bid Confirm Popup to the Customer.
If the Customer is not signed in, they are redirected to the Sign-in Page before being able to access the Product Details (Bidding) page.
If the auction has ended or is not active, the Customer cannot place a bid and may be directed to the No Results Search Page or see an inactive status on the Product Details page.
If the bid amount entered is invalid (e.g., below minimum increment), the system does not display the Bid Confirm Popup and instead prompts the Customer to correct the bid amount.

If the Customer enters a bid amount that is below the minimum required increment (e.g., 'Min. Bid' or 'Increm.' constraints), the system rejects the submission and prompts the Customer to enter a valid higher amount.

If the auction item's status changes to 'Ended' or 'Cancelled' while the Customer is attempting to place a bid, the system prevents the bid submission and may redirect the Customer to the 'No Results Search Page' or display an error indicating the auction is no longer active.
If the Customer's session expires or they are not signed in when attempting to submit a bid, the system redirects them to the 'Sign-in Page' before allowing any bidding action.
The Customer's bid is recorded in the system and associated with their account.
The Customer receives a confirmation of their bid via the Bid Confirm Popup.
The 'My Current Bids' page (or section) is updated to reflect the new bid placed by the Customer.
